title: Fixed signs in love
caption: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius: loyal, steady, and yes, a little stubborn. Tag the most loyal one you know.

beats.head: Dating a *fixed* sign? Read this first.
Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, *Aquarius.*
beats.sub: One from every element, each in the middle of a season.

beats.head: Fixed means *loyal.*
beats.sub: Once they choose you, they keep choosing you.

beats.head: Fixed also means *stubborn.*
beats.sub: Changing their mind takes time, not pressure.

beats.head: Taurus holds on with *routine.*
beats.sub: Same spot, same order, same person. That's devotion.

beats.head: Leo holds on with *warmth.*
beats.sub: Big loyalty, big gestures. Just remember to clap.

beats.head: Scorpio holds on with *depth.*
beats.sub: Trust is earned slowly, then protected for good.

beats.head: Aquarius holds on with *freedom.*
beats.sub: Loyal to you, as long as they can stay themselves.

beats.head: Disagreeing with a fixed sign? *Pause,* don't push.
beats.sub: Give them space to land on it themselves.

beats.head: Tag the most *loyal* fixed sign you know.
